Grok Connectors just went live for every user, not just premium.

That's the part worth paying attention to.

When a feature launches behind a paywall, adoption is slow. When it launches for everyone at once, it becomes a new default. Every Grok user on iOS, Android and grok.com can now connect their email, calendar, slides and Notion directly.

What changes:

~ Grok can fetch your emails without you forwarding anything
~ Grok can check your calendar when you ask what's on today
~ Grok can organize your Notion without you describing the structure
~ You @mention the connector, Grok does the rest

The AI assistant category just shifted. Most competitors charge for this. Grok is making it the baseline.
